issue.title: Observe reference UX on supported desktop operating systems
issue.build: Observe reference desktop apps on their supported operating systems to settle details static inspection cannot prove.
accept: Use the recorded macOS artifacts for macOS and separately identified Windows packages for Windows, with authorized test accounts/Profiles. Linux has no official reference product.
Cover Peek/pin URL rules, tab handoff, folder preview, split transitions, sidebar reveal, media return and native dialogs with screenshots/recordings and scenario notes.
Separate platform differences, retired actions and inaccessible login-dependent features; update affected acceptance criteria instead of claiming generic parity.
issue.readiness: Proposed work after native/reference prerequisites and explicit decisions in this issue.
issue.disposition: Recommended core integration or verification, with improvements preferred over literal Arc replication.
issue.referencePlatforms: Reference platform support is limited to the cited source. Documentary macOS or Windows coverage does not prove native behavior; Linux is a downstream design and verification target.
issue.referenceNote: REA 6.7.0 bundle/resource observations recorded in artifacts.md; no application execution or native-performance measurement.
issue.openQuestions: Only macOS images were acquired in this investigation; Windows acquisition and supported hosts/accounts remain prerequisites to Windows observations.
